claims: Hungary is a landlocked Central European country.
Hungary has a population of nearly 9.8 million.
Budapest is the capital of Hungary.
Hungary is a high-income EU member.
Hungary is governed as a parliamentary republic.
Hungary transitioned from a communist state to a market economy.
Hungary is located in the Carpathian Basin.
Hungary borders Austria, Slovakia, Ukraine, Romania, Serbia, Croatia, and Slovenia.
The Danube and Tisza rivers and Lake Balaton are key geographical features of Hungary.
The Prime Minister is the head of government in Hungary.
The President is the head of state in Hungary.
Hungary was founded in the 9th century by Magyars.
Hungarian (Magyar) is the official language of Hungary.
Hungary has a high-income market-oriented economy.
Fisherman's Bastion is part of Budapest's architecture.
Buda Castle is part of Budapest's architecture.
Hortobágy National Park is a tourist attraction in Hungary
